headline: 4 predicted models across 1 accessions. 0 were served by the AlphaFold host and 0 were computed by AlphaFold.
interpretation: The provenance of the `structures.predicted` scalars on the landing page. Each accession's predicted models are counted three ways that the page's single `predicted_model_count` collapses into one: by the provider that served the model, by the tool that computed it, and by model category. Nothing here is a new capability and nothing here changes a rank; it re-asks one tool already in the toolkit for the same accessions the held-out run reached, and keeps the list that the chain record reduces to a count.
limitations: The AlphaFold host's name is not the provenance of what it serves. Every model provider `AlphaFold DB` returned for these accessions was computed by ColabFold v1.5.2, so `alphafold_host_served_models: true` must not be read as 'AlphaFold modelled this protein'. `alphafold_authored_model_count` is counted from each model's `tool_used`, which is the only field that answers that.

ColabFold is counted apart from AlphaFold rather than folded into it. It runs the same network weights behind a different MSA pipeline, which makes it AlphaFold-derived and still not an AlphaFold DB model.

A predicted model is not experimental evidence that the protein adopts the modelled conformation, and a high pLDDT is a statement about the predictor's confidence rather than an observation of the fold.

pLDDT (0-100) and QMEANDisCo (0-1) are different quantities, not one quantity rescaled. Averages are grouped by metric and never merged. An accession whose models are all template-based carries no pLDDT at all, so the `confident_plddt` threshold the page prints does not apply to it.

A predicted-model count is not an attention proxy and must never be pooled with deposited-structure counts. Experimentally determined entries are partitioned out here and counted in `excluded_experimental_count` only.
Absence is recorded, not inferred. `alphafold_host_served_models: false` on Q3LZX1 is a measured absence -- the host was asked unconditionally and holds nothing -- and not a request that was skipped.

The accessions are read out of the landing record's held-out case rather than written here, so this inventory covers the relatives the chain actually reached. It says nothing about SARS-CoV-2's own P0DTD1, whose curated entries that case deletes before the run.
